_comment: Group 1 of 3: the branch cannot be deleted or force-pushed, by anyone.
Applies to every repo, including ones with no CI and no PR habit yet -- it costs
nothing and is the part whose absence is unrecoverable.
bypass_actors is empty on purpose. A bypass actor is a standing exception nothing
audits; a fleet survey on 2026-09-29 found 6 of 8 ruleset repos with none, and the
~DEFAULT_BRANCH, not refs/heads/main: it survives a default-branch rename and covers
a repo still on master. The old single protect-main ruleset stayed on refs/heads/main
only because changing it would have reported drift everywhere at once; these are new
rulesets, so there is no installed base to disagree with.
GitHub ignores unknown members, and apply.sh strips every _comment* key anyway.
name: branch-safety
